b2-nemzetisegek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Mosaic of Peoples
b2-nemzetisegek-01.scenario: At the ethnographic museum, a visitor asks you how so many peoples came to live in the Carpathian Basin and how the villagers got on.
b2-nemzetisegek-01.prompt: Tell the visitor what happened after the Turkish wars and what the villagers learned from one another.
cues: Say what happened after the Turkish wars
Say what the villagers learned from one another
b2-nemzetisegek-01.target: A török hódoltság után a betelepítések során különböző nemzetiségek költöztek be. A falvak lakói egymástól tanulták a mesterségeket.
b2-nemzetisegek-01.english: After the Ottoman period, different nationalities moved in during the resettlements. The villagers learned the crafts from one another.
b2-nemzetisegek-01.canDo: I can describe the historical settlement patterns and coexistence of ethnic communities in Hungary.

b2-nemzetisegek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dohány Street Synagogue
b2-nemzetisegek-02.scenario: In front of the Dohány Street Synagogue, a tourist asks you when it was consecrated and how Jewish and non-Jewish intellectuals worked in the city.
b2-nemzetisegek-02.prompt: Tell the tourist when the synagogue was consecrated and how Jewish and non-Jewish intellectuals worked in the coffee-houses.
cues: Say when the synagogue was consecrated
Say how Jewish and non-Jewish intellectuals worked in the coffee-houses
b2-nemzetisegek-02.target: A Dohány utcai zsinagógát 1859-ben szentelték fel. A kávéházakban a zsidó és nem zsidó értelmiségiek szorosan egymás mellett alkottak.
b2-nemzetisegek-02.english: The Dohány Street Synagogue was consecrated in 1859. In the coffee-houses, Jewish and non-Jewish intellectuals created side by side.
b2-nemzetisegek-02.canDo: I can describe the history, architecture, and cultural role of Budapest's historical Jewish Quarter.

b2-nemzetisegek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Primás and Family
b2-nemzetisegek-03.scenario: At a folk-music evening in Budapest, a guest asks you about a famous Roma primás and how the musician families kept their art alive.
b2-nemzetisegek-03.prompt: Tell the guest the name of a famous primás and how the musician families passed on their skill.
cues: Say how the musician families passed on their skill
b2-nemzetisegek-03.target: Bihari János híres prímás volt. A zenészdinasztiák családonként adták tovább a tudást.
b2-nemzetisegek-03.english: János Bihari was a famous primás. The musician dynasties passed on their skill family by family.
b2-nemzetisegek-03.canDo: I can describe the rich musical, artistic, and social heritage of Hungary's Roma communities.

b2-nemzetisegek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Serbs in Szentendre
b2-nemzetisegek-04.scenario: In Szentendre, a friend from abroad asks you who built the baroque churches and what helps the communities understand each other today.
b2-nemzetisegek-04.prompt: Tell your friend who built the baroque churches in Szentendre and what helps the communities understand one another.
cues: Say who built the baroque churches in Szentendre
Say what helps the communities understand one another
b2-nemzetisegek-04.target: Szentendrén a törökök elől menekülő szerbek barokk templomokat emeltek. A kétnyelvű iskolák az egymás iránti megértést is segítik.
b2-nemzetisegek-04.english: In Szentendre the Serbs fleeing from the Turks built baroque churches. Bilingual schools also help mutual understanding.
b2-nemzetisegek-04.canDo: I can compare the cultural heritage of German (Swabian), Slovak, and South Slavic communities in Hungary.

b2-nemzetisegek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Self-Government in Practice
b2-nemzetisegek-05.scenario: At a conference on nationality self-governments, a delegate asks you what the local self-governments do and what the advocate in Parliament may do.
b2-nemzetisegek-05.prompt: Tell the delegate what the local nationality self-governments organise and what right the advocate has in the National Assembly.
cues: Say what the local nationality self-governments organise
Say what right the advocate has in the National Assembly
b2-nemzetisegek-05.target: A települési nemzetiségi önkormányzatok a helyi közösségek kulturális életét szervezik. A nemzetiségi szószólónak felszólalási joga van az Országgyűlésben.
b2-nemzetisegek-05.english: The local nationality self-governments organise the cultural life of the local communities. The nationality advocate has the right to speak in the National Assembly.
b2-nemzetisegek-05.canDo: I can explain the legal framework, electoral system, and institutional responsibilities of nationality self-governments.

b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Thirteen Nationalities
b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a heritage tour, the guide asks you how many nationalities the law names and how the communities lived after the resettlements.
b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.prompt: Tell the guide how many nationalities the law names and how the communities lived after the resettlements.
cues: Say how many nationalities the law names
Say how the communities lived after the resettlements
b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.target: A nemzetiségi törvény tizenhárom nemzetiséget nevesít. A betelepítések után a közösségek egymás mellett éltek, és egymástól tanultak.
b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.english: The Nationality Act names thirteen nationalities. After the resettlements the communities lived side by side and learned from one another.
b2-nemzetisegek-consolidation.canDo: I can synthesize the historical and cultural heritage of Hungary's 13 nationalities and Jewish community.
